q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Wang Lei. I’m fourteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in the south-west of China. I live with my mum, my dad and my little sister. I use my mobile phone every day after school, mostly to message my friends, but my parents don’t let me use it for too long. My favourite time of day is the morning, because I feel fresh and the city is quiet. In the future I’d like to visit Japan, because I love Japanese food and culture. I like listening to rock music because it gives me lots of energy. I don’t really enjoy shopping – it’s boring for me, so I usually buy things online. In the future I’d like to study computer science, because I want to make games. On TV I like watching sports programmes, especially basketball, because it’s exciting. I like reading comics, because they’re funny and easy to read.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答不只回答“是/不是”或一个词，而是给出具体信息并说明理由（because…），用一般现在时谈习惯，用 I’d like to… 谈将来的愿望，每个问题说 1–3 句。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photo I can see three people in a kitchen. I think it’s a mother and her two children. They’re sitting around a big table. The mother has got glasses and she’s working on a laptop – maybe she’s working from home. On the left there’s a girl with long hair. She’s writing something in a notebook, so I think she’s doing her homework. On the right there’s a boy. He’s also writing in a book and he looks very busy. There’s a pencil case on the table too. In the background I can see some lamps, a clock on the wall and some plants near the window. The kitchen looks bright and clean. I think it’s afternoon and they’re all studying or working together.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答按顺序描述照片：人物（是谁、穿什么、在做什么）、地点、其他细节；用现在进行时，遇到不确定的地方用 I think / maybe / It looks like… 猜测，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, a flute is a nice idea, because the winner can practise with it. But you’re right – maybe the winner is a singer, or plays the guitar, so a flute isn’t useful for everyone. I like the tickets. Going to a show is a special experience and the winner can see great performers. I agree about the flowers. They’re pretty, but after a few days they die, so they aren’t a good prize. The hoodie is cool, and the winner can wear it at school and remember the competition. But some people don’t like wearing the same clothes as others. The watch is useful every day, but it isn’t really about music. The CDs are about music, but nowadays most people listen to music online. In my opinion, the tickets are the best, because they’re special and they’re about music. Yes, let’s choose the tickets!

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），把每个奖品和“奖励音乐比赛的冠军”这一目的联系起来，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的奖品。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have. Last year I entered a drawing competition at school. I didn’t win, but it was fun. I’ve been to a concert once, with my cousin. It was a pop concert and I really enjoyed it, because everyone was singing and dancing. At the moment I’m learning to play the piano. It’s quite difficult to learn, because you have to use both hands, but I practise every day. I prefer listening to music when I’m happy, because it makes me feel even better. When I’m sad I like quiet music. I think it’s very important for a film to have good music, because music shows the feelings of the characters and makes the story more exciting.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都表明观点并给出理由或例子，用现在完成时谈经历（Have you ever…? → Yes, I have…），用一般过去时补充细节，用 I prefer / I think / because 表达看法，还可以从正反两方面谈。
